metadata.description: Product marketing that compounds. Skills for B2B SaaS PMMs and GTM operators that start from one shared company brain: positioning, battlecards, call prep, GTM plans and weekly competitive briefs for Claude Code and Claude.

plugins.name: pmm-go-to-market
plugins.description: Pick the first segment, tier the launch, plan the motion. Beachhead scoring, launch tiers and GTM briefs, motion selection and multi-skill programs.

plugins.name: pmm-positioning
plugins.description: Know who you sell to, who else they consider and why you win. ICP, alternatives map, buyer personas, market context, brand voice, positioning statements, message house, proof points and messaging playbooks.

plugins.name: pmm-execution
plugins.description: Run the PMM week: PRDs, OKRs, pre-mortems, retros, stakeholder maps, interview summaries, experiment docs and prioritization frameworks.

plugins.name: pmm-growth
plugins.description: Find the next angle and prove it worked. North Star Metric and scorecard, positioning angles, campaign ideas, value-prop variants and checked customer stories.

plugins.name: pmm-intelligence
plugins.description: Know what changed this week. At most five opportunities from signals you name, each tied to your brain and your quarterly priorities.

plugins.name: pmm-competitive-intelligence
plugins.description: Know what your competitors did this week and what to say about it. A scheduled sweep with the fixes drafted, dated profiles, live-deal battlecards, comparison pages, deep-dives, a weekly leadership brief and a weekly industry newsletter, with answers your team can get in Slack.

plugins.name: pmm-sales
plugins.description: Help sellers win the deal in front of them. Slack first: review a live deal, prep and score discovery calls, handle an objection, catch up on a customer, research a prospect and see which deals need you, all checked against your brain and sourced to your CRM, calls and email.

plugins.name: pmm-toolkit
plugins.description: Everyday PMM utilities: a writing assistant for internal and marketing content, resume review, a privacy policy generator and GACCS campaign briefs.

plugins.name: pmm-meta
plugins.description: Keep the skills honest: skill review, session learning, cross-skill synthesis and output verification.

plugins.name: product-marketing-context
plugins.description: The brain. Builds and maintains /foundation/brain.md, the context every other plugin reads before it writes. Build it once; stop re-explaining your product.
